raw: {"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["Prerequisites for CS2109S (MA1511/MA1512 or MA1521 or MA2002 etc.) are not satisfied by completed courses; MA1521 is completed but CS2109S requires (YSC2229 or CS2040S...) AND ((MA1511 and MA1512) or MA1521...). While MA1521 is completed, the first part requires YSC2229 (not offered) or CS2040S (completed). So CS2109S is eligible. However, CS4226 requires (CS2105 or EE3204...) and (EE2012A or EE2012 or MA2216 or ST2131 or ST2334 or MA2116 or MA2116T). Student has ST2334. So CS4226 is eligible if CS2105 is taken. CS2105 requires CS2040 or CS2040S... Student has CS2040S. So CS2105 is eligible. CS4231 requires CS3210 or CS3230. Student has neither. CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed) or others. CS3230 requires CS2040S (completed) and CS1231S (completed). So CS3230 is eligible. CS3219 requires CS2103 (completed) or CS2103T (completed) etc. Student has CS2103T. So CS3219 is eligible. CS2106 requires CS2100 (completed). Eligible. The constraint 'CS4231 before CS2109S' is impossible because CS4231 requires CS3210 or CS3230. CS3230 is eligible now. CS3210 is eligible now. But CS2109S has no prerequisite on CS4231. The student says 'I need to finish CS4231 before I start CS2109S'. This is a student constraint, not a course prerequisite. However, CS4231 is offered Sem 2. CS2109S is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. If CS4231 is in Sem 2, CS2109S must be in a later semester. But the student also wants 'CS4226 and CS2109S together'. CS4226 is Sem 1. CS2109S is Sem 1, Sem 2. If they are together, they must be in Sem 1 (since CS4226 is only Sem 1). But CS4231 must be before CS2109S. If CS2109S is in Sem 1, CS4231 must be in a previous semester. The student is in Y2S2 (Sem 4). Previous semesters are 1,2,3. The student has completed courses up to Sem 4. They cannot take CS4231 in Sem 1,2,3 as it is not completed. The plan is from Sem 4 onwards. CS4231 cannot be in Sem 4 if CS2109S is in Sem 4 (must be strictly earlier). If CS2109S is in Sem 5, CS4231 must be in Sem 4. But CS4226 is Sem 1 only. It cannot be in Sem 5. So CS4226 and CS2109S cannot be together if CS2109S is in Sem 5. If CS2109S is in Sem 4, CS4231 must be in Sem <4, which is impossible. Thus, the constraints are contradictory."}
